Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! We're so glad to have you joining the marketing team next week.

I'm Emma Johnson, and I wanted to reach out with a warm welcome to help you feel comfortable and integrated into our team. If you have any questions about your onboarding, the team, or how we work, please don't hesitate to reach out — I'm happy to help.

Looking forward to working with you!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
